caseName: Oneida Indian Nation v. County of Oneida
caseNameFull: Oneida Indian Nation of New York v. County of Oneida, New York

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 412 U. S. 927.] Motion of State of New York for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae in support of respondents granted and State of New York to confine oral argument to questions presented. Motion for additional time to present oral argument denied.
